institution.name: Los Angeles County College of Nursing and Allied Health

plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Los Angeles County College of Nursing and Allied Health curriculum pages (dhs.lacounty.gov): the 'Basic Registered Nursing' curriculum plan (Semesters 1-4 with Theory/Laboratory units and the progression rule 'Successful completion of Semester N is pre-requisite to Semester N+1 courses', encoded as per-course prereqs) and the 'Prospective Student Admission Requirements' page (10 general-education prerequisite courses, 31 units: Human Anatomy with Lab 4, Human Physiology with Lab 4, Microbiology with Lab 4, College English Composition 3, Life Span Psychology 3, Sociology 3, Humanities 3, U.S. Political Science or U.S. History 3, Speech 101 3, PE/Kinesiology 1; taken at East Los Angeles College or another accredited college during or prior to the indicated semester). Catalog year 2026-2027 per the official CONAH Catalog 2026-2027 linked on the college's 'Who we are' page. GE prerequisites are encoded as a single prerequisite block (professional-phase convention); per-course credits = Theory + Laboratory units. The official Semester 1 table also lists an optional Nutrition elective (3.0 units), explicitly excluded from the 10.0 semester total and the 73-unit degree total; it is documented here and omitted from the encoded sequence. Degree total: 42 nursing units (21 theory + 21 clinical) + 31 GE units = 73. Graduates are eligible for the NCLEX-RN.
